name: Classical Phase Function Coefficient Calculation
definition: Computes coefficients c0, c1, c2, etc. for classical phase functions (Isotropic, Rayleigh, Hazzy, Murky) used in atmospheric scattering.
summary: Classical Phase Function Coefficient Calculation computes exact analytic coefficients for atmospheric scattering models, distinguishing itself from numerical quadrature by providing closed-form solutions for specific phase function types.
